test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

We frequently congratulate people on their __accomplishment__ in becoming famous, but we seldom ever talk about the price of fame.
solution: The correct answer is: **Fiasco**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**accomplishment**" means achievement or success. (उपलब्धि या सफलता) • **For example**: *She felt proud of her accomplishments.* • The phrase "price of fame" refers to the negative consequences or sacrifices that come with being famous. • The word "**fiasco**" means a complete failure or disaster. (पूर्ण विफलता या आपदा) • **For example**: *The party turned into a fiasco.* • In this context, the sentence is saying that we often celebrate people who become famous without acknowledging the difficulties they may face as a result. Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Execution **refers to the act of carrying out a plan or order, or the process of putting someone to death as a punishment. (किसी योजना या आदेश को क्रियान्वित करने का कार्य, या किसी को सज़ा के तौर पर मौत की सज़ा देने की प्रक्रिया) • **Feat **means an impressive achievement or accomplishment. (एक प्रभावशाली उपलब्धि या सिद्धि) • **Triumph **means a great victory or success. (एक बड़ी जीत या सफलता) 35:T603, The correct answer is: "**Sneha caught it and frowned.**"
